title: meet
description: The greatest lower bound of two elements of a lattice, a ∧ b — the largest element below both. Conjunction in logic, intersection in sets; unique by the order's antisymmetry; right-adjoined by the Heyting implication.

operation.description: a binary operation ∧ : carrier × carrier → carrier

greatest-lower-bound.description: a ∧ b is a lower bound of {a,b} and the greatest such — its universal property
